records.source: I do all my grocery shopping here.$h
records.translation: Dito ako namimili ng lahat ng pagkain ko.$h

records.source: Erm... Doctor Harvey? This is completely confidential, right?
records.translation: Ah... Doktor Harvey? Lubos itong kompidensiyal, hindi ba?

records.source: You know, I've purchased some of my favorite items from this market...
records.translation: Alam mo, nabili ko sa pamilihang ito ang ilan sa mga paborito kong bagay...

records.source: Even someone like me needs to warm up indoors now and then.
records.translation: Kahit ang isang tulad ko ay kailangang magpainit sa loob paminsan-minsan.

records.source: These people are travelers, like me... I feel a connection. But I'm okay just staying here to listen and watch.
records.translation: Mga manlalakbay ang mga taong ito, gaya ko... Nakakaramdam ako ng kaugnayan. Pero ayos lang sa akin na manatili rito upang makinig at manood.

records.source: I'm going to sleep well tonight.$h
records.translation: Mahimbing ang tulog ko mamayang gabi.$h

records.source: Erm... Doctor Harvey? This is completely confidential, right?
records.translation: Ah... Doktor Harvey? Lubos itong kompidensiyal, hindi ba?

records.source: Oohh... Fine purple silk. You can't find that at JojaMart!
records.translation: Oohh... Pinong lilang sutla. Hindi ka makakahanap niyan sa JojaMart!

records.source: I think Jas actually likes going to the doctor. What an unusual little girl.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, gusto talaga ni Jas ang pagpunta sa doktor. Kakaibang bata.

records.source: We're here for a 1:30pm appointment.
records.translation: Nakatakda kami nang 1:30 n.h.

records.source: Erm... Doctor Harvey? When you give her the shots, can we have two lollipops?
records.translation: Ah... Doktor Harvey? Kapag tinurukan mo siya, maaari ba kaming makakuha ng dalawang lollipop?

records.source: I'm at work, honey! Don't let the doctor see.
records.translation: Nagtatrabaho ako, mahal! Huwag mong hayaang makita ka ng doktor.

records.source: It's nice for you to visit me.$h
records.translation: Masaya akong dinalaw mo ako.$h

records.source: I'm almost off work...
records.translation: Malapit nang matapos ang trabaho ko...

records.source: Hey! Mom seems to be doing okay without my help. She's a tough lady.
records.translation: Uy! Mukhang ayos naman si Mama kahit wala ang tulong ko. Matatag siyang babae.

records.source: Dad's making good progress on his experiment.
records.translation: Maganda ang pagsulong ni Papa sa eksperimento niya.

records.source: I hope Penny decides to get married some day.
records.translation: Sana ay magpasya si Penny na magpakasal balang araw.

records.source: It's hard to really grasp the scale of the universe.$8
records.translation: Mahirap talagang maunawaan ang lawak ng sansinukob.$8

records.source: Wow, the tech on this thing is amazing!
records.translation: Wow, kahanga-hanga ang teknolohiya ng bagay na ito!

records.source: *grumble*... Doctor know-it-all... *grumble*$4
records.translation: *bulung-bulong*... Doktor na akala'y alam ang lahat... *bulung-bulong*$4

records.source: How much do I drink every day? What kind of a question is that?$u
records.translation: Gaano karami ang iniinom ko araw-araw? Anong klaseng tanong iyan?$u

records.source: Hi, honey. It's nice of you to visit me at work.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Ang saya namang dinalaw mo ako sa trabaho.$h

records.source: Hi, honey! I'm just doing some shopping.
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal! Namimili lang ako.

records.source: Don't worry, I'm using my own money to buy this.
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala, sarili kong pera ang ginagamit ko rito.

records.source: I wonder if Maru will get married some day?
records.translation: Magpapakasal kaya si Maru balang araw?

records.source: I'm going to go inside, I just wanted a quiet moment.
records.translation: Papasok na ako, gusto ko lang ng tahimik na sandali.

records.source: Can you smell that? The air is so spicy here...
records.translation: Naaamoy mo ba iyon? Napakaanghang ng hangin dito...

records.source: I have an appointment at the clinic this afternoon.
records.translation: May takdang pagpapatingin ako sa klinika ngayong hapon.

records.source: Hey! A little privacy, please?$a
records.translation: Uy! Bigyan mo naman ako ng kaunting pribasiya, pakiusap?$a

records.source: I've been working hard all week. I deserve a little relaxation on a Friday night.
records.translation: Buong linggo akong nagsikap. Karapat-dapat akong magpahinga nang kaunti sa Biyernes ng gabi.

records.source: We meet every week to encourage each other to stay healthy.
records.translation: Nagtitipon kami linggo-linggo upang hikayatin ang isa’t isa na manatiling malusog.

records.source: What's a healthy young person like you doing here?
records.translation: Ano ang ginagawa rito ng isang malusog na kabataang tulad mo?

records.source: Nothing bad to report, Doc. I feel as healthy as ever.
records.translation: Walang masamang maibabalita, Dok. Kasinglusog ko pa rin gaya ng dati.

records.source: My favorite thing is seeing the boats. The creaking sound of the wood is strangely comforting.
records.translation: Paborito kong pagmasdan ang mga bangka. Kakatwang nakaaaliw ang langitngit ng kahoy.

records.source: I gotta go visit Uncle Doctor today... Great.$7
records.translation: Kailangan kong dalawin si Tito Doktor ngayon... Ayos.$7

records.source: I'm a healthy boy, doc. Can I go now? This is boring.
records.translation: Malusog akong bata, Dok. Maaari na ba akong umalis? Nakakabagot ito.

records.source: I just got out of the doctor's office. Completely healthy and vigorous, just as I expected.$h
records.translation: Kalalabas ko lang sa tanggapan ng doktor. Ganap na malusog at masigla, gaya ng inaasahan ko.$h

records.source: Don't tell my mom... but I really just came over for a free lunch.$h
records.translation: Huwag mong sabihin kay Mama... pero pumunta lang talaga ako para sa libreng tanghalian.$h

records.source: Sorry, honey. I'm trying to concentrate here... $7
records.translation: Paumanhin, mahal. Sinusubukan kong magpokus dito... $7

records.source: Mom seems okay. A little overworked, maybe.
records.translation: Mukhang ayos naman si Mama. Baka medyo napapagod lang.

records.source: Vincent seems a little lonely without me around. I used to play with him a lot.
records.translation: Mukhang medyo nalulungkot si Vincent kapag wala ako. Madalas ko siyang kalaro noon.

records.source: Nothing like an ice cold Joja Cola on a sopping wet day, huh?#$e#Just kidding. Hehehe.$h
records.translation: Walang tatalo sa napakalamig na Joja Cola sa isang basang-basang araw, ano?#$e#Nagbibiro lang ako. Hehehe.$h

records.source: Maybe if all else fails, I'll become a submarine captain. That might be cool.
records.translation: Kung hindi umubra ang lahat, baka maging kapitan ako ng submarino. Mukhang astig iyon.

records.source: Strange, isn't it?
records.translation: Kakaiba, hindi ba?

records.source: I had a great time.$h#$b#Thanks for being my friend.$h#$e#Come back again any time!$h
records.translation: Napakasaya ko.$h#$b#Salamat sa pagiging kaibigan ko.$h#$e#Bumalik ka anumang oras!$h

records.source: I think she sells some rare products.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, nagbebenta siya ng ilang bihirang produkto.

records.source: Oh, Emily! I was hoping you'd show up!$h#$b#I was actually feeling a little lonely this morning.#$e#But I'm glad you're here!$h
records.translation: Ah, Emily! Umaasa akong darating ka!$h#$b#Medyo nalulungkot talaga ako kaninang umaga.#$e#Pero natutuwa akong narito ka!$h

records.source: How's that Stardew Valley weather right now?#$e#The flowers there smell lovely.$h
records.translation: Kumusta ang panahon sa Stardew Valley ngayon?#$e#Napakabango ng mga bulaklak doon.$h

records.source: It always seems to stay a little cooler by the lake.#$e#It's good to get out of the house now and then!$h
records.translation: Mukhang palaging mas malamig nang kaunti sa tabi ng lawa.#$e#Masarap lumabas ng bahay paminsan-minsan!$h

records.source: Should I let Sam win for once? ...nah.$h
records.translation: Hahayaan ko bang manalo si Sam kahit minsan? ...hindi.$h

records.source: I'm going to hang out with my old friends tonight. I'll be home later.
records.translation: Makikipagkita ako sa mga dati kong kaibigan ngayong gabi. Uuwi ako mamaya.

records.source: My skills haven't declined... Sam's still just as easy to beat.$h
records.translation: Hindi humina ang kakayahan ko... Madali pa ring talunin si Sam.$h

records.source: Standing at this spot really makes me want a smoke... but I'm determined to quit now.
records.translation: Kapag nakatayo ako rito, talagang gusto kong manigarilyo... pero determinado na akong tumigil.

records.source: Mom's face lit up when I walked in. She deserves to be happy.$7
records.translation: Lumiwanag ang mukha ni Mama nang pumasok ako. Karapat-dapat siyang maging masaya.$7

records.source: The ocean is best enjoyed alone... don't you think?
records.translation: Pinakamasarap mag-isa sa tabi ng karagatan... hindi ba?
